reviews.title: Feature Request: Monthly Weight Tracking & Progress Photos ⭐
reviews.text:
Hi! I really enjoy using your app, and I have a few feature suggestions that I think would make it even better.

I love that we can see the monthly average calorie intake. It would be amazing if you could add the same type of monthly tracking for body weight. Right now, weight is only shown weekly, which isn’t very helpful for seeing long-term progress. A weekly and monthly weight graph would be much more useful.

Another feature I’d absolutely love is a progress photo section. It would be great if users could take or upload photos at the beginning and end of each month to compare their body composition over time. Sometimes the scale doesn’t change much, but photos show real progress.

These features would make the app so much more complete, and I honestly wouldn’t need a separate app anymore.

If you add these features, I’ll happily keep my subscription and recommend your app to everyone I know. Thank you for creating such a great app, and I hope you’ll consider these ideas!

reviews.title: Love it but data capture has been off
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for a long time, but recently the barcode scanner almost never works anymore, even with very common, popular foods. Additionally, when I use the nutrition capture feature or describe a food manually, the app frequently populates incorrect nutritional information that doesn’t match what I entered. It feels like it’s pulling pre-filled data from the database and forcing it onto my entry, which ends up corrupting my nutrition tracking. Accurate tracking is one of the main reasons I use the app, so this has become very frustrating. I’d really appreciate an update that improves barcode recognition and ensures manual nutrition capture uses the information the user actually provides instead of overriding it with potentially incorrect database entries. Thank you!

reviews.title: Do not try the 1-week trial unless you plan to pay for a 1-year subscription!
reviews.text: They will charge you for the year subscription even if you cancel your one-week trial.  You will not get refunded through the Apple, even with proof that you cancelled (as I did have a screen shot).  One of my messages to Apple finally was forwarded to the makers of the Eato app.  Their solution was to let me keep the Eato app and offer me a discounted price on some of their other apps..HOW IS THAT A SOLUTION!  I just wanted my money back for the charge that I did not authorize.  BTW---I tried the one week trial because I was skeptical that this would actually work...and, as I thought, of course it doesn't!  Think about it...even if it identifies yogurt (which if it is plain yogurt alone in a bowl, identifying it would be a guess at best, but with berries and granola at least they can make an educated guess based on context of the foods it is paired with...still, it cannot know if it is regular, light, Greek, plain, etc, which vary in caloric content.  Needless to say, nothing I tested it on was even remotely close. If you trust it, don't complain when you have to buy some new jeans in 6 months because the app is giving you false information and you are believing it.  DISHONEST COMPANY because they charge you for subscription WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION  AND YOU WILL NOT GET BACK, also HORRIBLE PRODUCT because it does not deliver on doing what it says it can do.  DO NOT DO THE FREE TRIAL UNLESS YOU PLAN ON PAYING FOR A YEAR SUBSCRIPTION THAT YOU WILL LIKELY DELETE OFF YOUR PHONE ONCE YOU TRY IT ANYWAY!

reviews.title: Almost perfect!

I love the meal plan and all the recipes because I’m terrible with knowing what to make which contributes to me eating junk so I think this app is totally worth the cost. My only one complaint is that I wish there was a way to upload your own recipe or meal into the meal plan. As of now you can only swap the meals with other recipes that are in the app, but sometimes I eat other meals that I’m not using from the app, so it would be nice to add your own. You can add your own custom individual meals and log different food you ate but you can’t add it to the meal plan and it drives my OCD up the wall cuz I wanna check it off the list that I ate it 🤣 If we can get that piece updated this app is chefs kiss! 🤌🏼
